name: Blisters on The Land
summary: In the eastern Wetlands, Rethiel senses sickness spreading through the marsh. The bog beast warden asks travelers to destroy Fen Creepers, hoping to ease the land's rising fever.

sections.title: A Festering Marshes
sections.body: Rethiel the Greenwarden watches the Wetlands from a grove among the marshes. The mire has always been harsh, but now an unnatural sickness spreads through it. Rethiel senses a fever in the earth, warping wild nature into mindless, shambling horrors.

sections.title: Cleansing the Fen
sections.body: Fen Creepers are decaying masses of swamp vegetation that wander the waterways. Rethiel calls them diseased blisters swelling on the land. Their tormented presence agitates the marsh, so Rethiel asks passing allies to destroy them and let their tangled remains settle into the mud.

aliases: who gives blisters on the land
faq.answer: Rethiel the Greenwarden is a bog beast who lives at Greenwarden's Grove in the eastern Wetlands. Rethiel tends the marsh's natural balance and works to soothe its afflictions and curb corrupted elemental growth.
Fen Creepers are hostile plant and bog elementals that roam the Wetlands waterways. They are hulking, shambling masses of animated vines, mud, and decaying marsh plants.

faq.q: Why does Rethiel want the Fen Creepers destroyed?
faq.answer: Rethiel sees the Fen Creepers as fevered signs of the marsh's growing sickness. Rethiel believes destroying them lets their forms dissolve into the earth and soothes the agitated land.

faq.q: What causes the festering in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: Rethiel does not know what is causing the festering in the Wetlands. Rethiel senses the land's distress and calms elemental unrest wherever it rises.

faq.q: Where are Fen Creepers found in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: Fen Creepers roam the Wetlands' damp waterways, muddy banks, and central channels, especially near the deeper bogs west of Greenwarden's Grove.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to other tasks for Rethiel?
faq.answer: Yes. Rethiel's concern about the Mosshide gnolls burning Wetlands trees led to Fire Taboo. Rethiel continues working to protect the marsh's balance.

angles.text: Rethiel's work reflects a druid's duty to heal the natural world and calm agitated elemental blights so the earth can return to balance.
As a Night Elf, you may find a solitary bog beast warden allied with Stormwind in the Eastern Kingdoms. Even the land's own spirits seek help to heal wounded land.
Fen Creepers twist earth and water, so destroying them helps pacify discordant elemental spirits.
